scope: Resolves, as far as raw source evidence allows, the 99 menu-metadata.json item ids that had no name field in calculator-menu.json, menu-rules.json, or online-meals.json. Analysis only; no importer built; no raw files modified.
methodology: Recomputed the 99-id list from scratch by intersecting menu-metadata.json's 408 items against calculator-menu.json's 192 ids and menu-rules.json's 328 ids (name index built from both), then excluding ids resolvable via menu-metadata.itemGroups[...].defaultItemId. Result matched the prior source-analysis.json finding exactly (99 ids).

For every id, collected every menu-metadata field: nutrition (Calories+Portion), thumbnailUrl, dietaryTags, tags (promo/tagline/rewards), customizations, groupName, showCustomizationNameWhenSelected/showCustomizationPrice/isRewardsExclusive.
Cross-referenced menu-metadata.itemSections (31 named sections) and menu-metadata.groups (18 display groups) for any entry whose items[].menuItemId equals the target id.

Deep-searched calculator-menu.json, menu-rules.json, and online-meals.json for the literal id string anywhere in the JSON tree (not just as a top-level/nested itemId) — zero hits for any of the 99 in any of the three files, confirming they are genuinely absent from the restaurant-469 and national-rules ordering graphs, not just unresolved by name.

Additionally computed exact thumbnailUrl string matches between each unresolved id and every ALREADY-named menu-metadata item (from calculator-menu/menu-rules) — an id sharing a pixel-identical product photo with a known, named item is treated as strong corroborating evidence of real-world identity, distinct from and stronger than a thumbnail-filename guess alone.

classificationCriteria.confidently_identified: At least one of: (a) exact thumbnailUrl match to an already-named item, (b) menu-metadata.itemGroups displayName reachable via the record's own groupName field, (c) a 'tagline' marketing-copy tag combined with a non-generic thumbnail filename that together describe a specific product.
classificationCriteria.likely_identified: A non-generic, specific thumbnail filename slug exists (e.g. cmg-6606-chorizo) but no tagline/groupName/exact-photo-match corroborates it — the image filename is the only evidence, and image filenames are not an authoritative structured name field.
classificationCriteria.completely_unknown: Thumbnail URL is the generic https://www.chipotle.com/ placeholder (not a real product image) and no itemSections/groups/tagline reference exists either. No name was invented for these.

summary.note: All 99 ids are, by construction, absent from calculator-menu.json (restaurant 469's active sellable menu). The deep-search step additionally confirmed zero of them appear anywhere in menu-rules.json or online-meals.json either — they exist ONLY in the national menu-metadata.json catalog.
